title: Smelt emeralds for a totem
description: Smelting emerald for a totem of undying
body:
![the logo](https://i.imgur.com/E9lLtQe.png) This is my datapack i made when i was bored and decided to post it on modrinth. How it basically works: If you smelt a emerald it will give you a totem of undying. Sounds cool right?
![Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/8uH7f1j.png)
![Recipe results](https://i.imgur.com/5j7OYzw.png)
If you notice anything not working or any bugs please let me know in the commments ill try and fix it!
I hope you enjoy my datapack (Attempts took: 24 i think) 🔥Smelt → Totem of undying✨ If possible i'll try and make new updates etc.
